welcome_message:
Hello! I am your personnal familiar and will store any reminders you give me. 
 Type /help to see the list of available commands or simply type /newreminder to write down an event you have to be reminded of!
unknown_user: It looks like I don't know you yet... Try typing /start to begin!
ask_reminder: Please tell me what you want to be reminded of!
error_saving: Oops! Something went wrong while saving.
ask_title: What is the title of the reminder?
ask_notes: Please provide any notes for this reminder:
invalid_time: Invalid time format. Please use HH:MM format:
ask_offset: How many hours prior should I remind you?
invalid_offset: Please enter a valid number for hours:
ask_timezone_setup: To make sure reminders arrive at the right time, please set your timezone. You can share your location for an automatic setup, or set it manually.
timezone_fail: Could not determine your timezone. Please try setting it manually.
no_reminders: You have no saved reminders right now.
